title: Crane Installer
salary_note: No salary given on the careers page — page must say 'Competitive salary'.
experience: Previous experience in crane installation, mechanical installation, construction, or a similar role is preferred
description_text:
Our client, a well-established company specialising in tower cranes, is looking to recruit a Crane Installer to join its team in Malta.
 The successful candidate will be responsible for the installation, assembly, dismantling and maintenance support of cranes at various construction sites.
 Responsibilities: 
 Installing and assembling crane components on construction sites.
 Assisting with the dismantling and relocation of cranes when required.
 Carrying out mechanical assembly and basic maintenance tasks.
 Using hand and power tools safely and correctly.
 Inspecting components and equipment before installation.
 Assisting with troubleshooting and reporting any technical issues.
 Working safely at height and following all health and safety procedures.
 Working closely with the installation team and site personnel.
 Ensuring tools and equipment are properly maintained and stored.
 Requirements: 
 Previous experience in crane installation, mechanical installation, construction, or a similar role is preferred.
 Good practical and mechanical skills.
 Comfortable working at heights and outdoors.
 Physically fit and able to perform manual work.
 Good knowledge of basic hand and power tools.
 Strong commitment to health and safety.
 Reliable, responsible and able to work well as part of a team.
 A valid driving licence is considered an advantage.
 Previous experience with tower cranes is an advantage.
 Only candidates currently residing in Malta will be considered for this position.
